descriptionFull: The rock wren ( Salpinctes obsoletus ) is a small songbird of the wren family native to South America and western North America. It is the only species in the genus Salpinctes . Adults are about 12 cm long. They have grey-brown upperparts with small black and white spots and pale grey underparts with a light brown rump.
